{{Top|leg}}

'''Drinks chillers''' were devices used to cool drinks. The device featured a chilling surface below an accent gas emitter, heat exchange vanes, and refrigeration tubes.<ref name="aotcvis">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> A drinks chiller was inside the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name=":0">{{Film|II}}</ref> a popular establishment<ref name="DB-Outlander Club">{{DB|location|outlandersclub|Outlander Club}}</ref> located in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]]<ref name="FF44">{{FactFile|44|COR 21-22|Coruscant &ndash; Outlander Club}}</ref> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name=":0" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="NEC2">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
